definitions.explanation: Horse meat eaten as food. The name comes from the pink, cherry-blossom-like color of the raw flesh, and it is used in place of the plainer {馬肉|ばにく} on menus and in polite conversation.

examples.japanese: {桜肉|さくらにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate horse meat for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{桜肉|さくらにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant is famous for its horse-meat sashimi.

examples.japanese: {熊本|くまもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{桜肉|さくらにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: In Kumamoto, the custom of eating horse meat has continued since long ago.

notes:
A euphemistic name for ⟦{馬肉|ばにく}→馬肉：30430_baniku⟧ (horse meat), from the pink color of the raw meat. Restaurants and shops normally use {桜肉|さくらにく}; ⟦{馬肉|ばにく}→馬肉：30430_baniku⟧ is the neutral technical term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜肉|さくらにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: horse-meat sashimi
- {桜肉|さくらにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat horse meat
- {桜肉|さくらにく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: horse-meat cuisine
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: hot pot made with horse meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
Animal meats have similar plant-based euphemisms:
- ⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}{肉|にく}→牡丹肉：30481_botanniku⟧: wild boar meat — from the peony-like arrangement of the sliced meat
- ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧: venison — from the autumn-leaf color
